title: Customer-holdout reranker eval bridge — per-customer NDCG/MRR & A/B traffic hooks
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement an evaluation bridge that computes NDCG and MRR per-customer prompt set using a customer-holdout strategy, and expose lightweight A/B traffic hooks so product teams can run controlled reranker experiments without affecting production latency above SLO. The bridge should: (1) capture a stratified sample of live rerank requests, (2) send golden/hypothesis scores to the eval pipeline asynchronously, (3) tag results by customer and AB cohort, and (4) surface per-customer time-series metrics and alerts when NDCG/MRR drift exceeds thresholds. This ticket covers the engineering integration, sampling contract, instrumentation schema, backfill plan for recent 7 days of traffic, and dashboards + alerting wiring.
acceptance_criteria: Stratified sampler implemented in rerank ingress: supports per-customer sampling rate and decaying reservoir for high-volume customers
Async scorer forwarder that writes hypothesis + baseline ranks to eval topic with customer, prompt_set_id, and cohort tags
NDCG and MRR computed in eval pipeline seeded with customer prompt sets and visible in console dashboard per-route and per-customer
A/B hook API that accepts cohort assignment and ensures <5ms p50 added latency on control path when enabled
Regression alerting: NDCG drop >5% or MRR drop >3% for a customer over 24h triggers pager/ops and creates a ticket with links to failing promptsets
Backfill job available to compute metrics for last 7 days using archived request logs and stored candidate labels
tasks: Define sampling spec (per-customer rate, reservoir size, stratify by query length and route)
Implement sampler and lightweight forwarder in rerank ingress service
Add message schema fields: customer_id, prompt_set_id, cohort, ground_truth_id, timestamp
Wire eval consumer to compute NDCG/MRR and push results to metrics pipeline
Create console dashboard with per-customer NDCG/MRR and cohort comparison visualization
Add alert rules and runbook for drift investigations
Documentation: sampling guarantees, expected overhead, and example AB flow for PMs
decisions: Use customer-holdout (customer-level) as primary slice to avoid contamination between cohorts
Sampling is adaptive: default 1% global, configurable up to 20% for targeted customers; large customers use decaying reservoir to bound telemetry volume
NDCG cutoff at rank-10 for metric computations to balance signal and compute cost
Compute NDCG/MRR asynchronously to keep serving path lean; store intermediate results in the eval kafka topic
risks: Telemetry volume from top customers could spike; needs rate-limiting and reservoir sampling
Ground-truth label availability: many customers lack explicit labels; require manual prompt-set curation or synthetic labeling fallback
Incorrect cohort assignment could bias experiments—need strict deterministic hashing and versioning of the cohort algorithm
Alert noise if thresholds not calibrated per-customer; we must provide baseline ranges in dashboard
